dialect.detail: Standard COBOL-85 style; no vendor-specific extensions visible. Likely compiled with GnuCOBOL or similar PC/student environment given relative file paths and naming conventions.

purpose.domain_detail: Sales and layaway transaction processing for a retail store; reads sales/layaway records from a prior program's output and processes them by transaction type, store number, and payment type.
purpose.summary: Program3 reads a sales-and-layaway records file produced by Program2 and is intended to process and report on transactions. The procedure division is incomplete (only opens files, does an initial read, then closes), suggesting it is a work-in-progress student assignment. It defines counters for transaction codes (S/L), store numbers, payment types, and tax calculations.

notable_features: Incomplete procedure division - only open/read/close implemented
Constants group for tax rate (0.13), transaction codes, store numbers, payment types
Counters for S-records, L-records, store counts, pay-type counts
Relative file paths suggesting PC/student environment
GOBACK used instead of STOP RUN
verdict.notes: The program is clearly a student exercise (author name, date-written April 1st 2018, 'Purpose: Write later' comment, incomplete procedure division). The file paths reference Program2 and Program3 directories suggesting a multi-program course assignment. No COMP-3, no SQL, no CICS. Dialect is ambiguous but likely GnuCOBOL on a PC given the relative paths and style.
